name: Replica Storyboard Directing
description: Deterministically compile accepted Replica source/target/audio/timing facts into TARGET_STORYBOARD and provider-sized GENERATION_SEGMENTS without re-inventing story or shot rhythm.
when_to_use: REPLICA has CURRENT SOURCE_VIDEO_SNAPSHOT, TARGET_BIBLE, TARGET_SCRIPT, TARGET_ASSETS, TARGET_AUDIO and overflow-free TIMING_PLAN
when_not_to_use: Any hard input is missing or STALE
The user wants to re-author story, scene order, or shot rhythm

steps.title: 校验生产链 lineage
steps.description: Require all six CURRENT inputs and an overflow-free Timing Plan.

steps.title: 编译目标分镜
steps.description: Inherit Source Shot order/timing/camera language and deterministically replace source identities with accepted target identities/assets.

steps.title: 拆分生成段
steps.description: Split each target storyboard shot into bounded provider inference windows without changing shot identity or timing lineage.

provider_rules: This skill is deterministic and must not create ProviderJob
Do not reorder scenes or shots, rewrite dialogue, or invent story events
Source actor/scene/prop identities must be mapped through TARGET_BIBLE before appearing in target visual prompts
GenerationSegment splitting changes inference windows only, never authoritative Source Shot timing
completion_criteria: Every Source Shot is represented exactly once as a TargetStoryboardShot
All referenced target identities have CURRENT target assets
Every GenerationSegment stays within configured max duration
Candidate is explicitly accepted before formal publication
failure_policy: Missing or stale hard input fails closed
No formal output is published before explicit review
